intro: Hoofprints trail away from the smoking remains of the Shady Rest Inn. A few are easy to see, while others are nearly lost in the soft marsh mud. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore is the one to report them to.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hoofprints, eh? It is true that there is an extraordinary amount of centaur activity in the lands near the Dustwallow Marsh. In brief excursions into the Barrens, we found their camps and holdings dotting the area.
I'll send out Falgran Hastil, one of our trackers, to see if he can find where the tracks lead.
